---
title: "IntroStatGPT"
description: "Using AI tools for the statistical computing in this course"
---

IntroStatGPT is how we do statistical computing in this course. You ask for a
table, a graph, or a model fit in ordinary language; IntroStatGPT runs R behind
the scenes and hands back the output, ready to check and drop into a report.
You never write code from scratch, and you are evaluated on concepts, not code.
What you still own is the important part: choosing the method, checking the
output, and deciding what it means.

## Start here

1. [Install and set up IntroStatGPT](introstatgpt/setup.qmd) — do this once,
   before you first use it. Activate your UT ChatGPT account, install R and the
   ChatGPT desktop app, download the IntroStatGPT folder, and run the setup.
2. [Use IntroStatGPT](introstatgpt/use.qmd) — the everyday workflow: find the
   available data, request an analysis, revise it, browse the gallery, organize
   your outputs, and compile a Word report.
3. [Working with IntroStatGPT](introstatgpt/working.qmd) — how to
   make requests that produce checkable output, how to check it, and what to
   save.

The course setup uses Codex with your UT ChatGPT account. If you already have a
Claude account with access to Claude Code, you may instead [set up IntroStatGPT
with Claude Code](introstatgpt/claude-code.qmd).

## Homework 1

<!-- Published harness ZIPs are immutable. Add a dated file and retire the old
link rather than replacing a ZIP in place. -->

Download [IntroStatGPT_homework_01_2026-08-28.zip](files/IntroStatGPT_homework_01_2026-08-28.zip)
(13 MB). This folder contains the current IntroStatGPT workspace, Homework 1,
and the course datasets. It works with Codex and Claude Code.

Use the workspace with these files:

1. [Homework 1: Describing and Comparing Distributions](files/homework-01.pdf)
   — the assignment. [Solutions (Canvas login required)](https://utexas.instructure.com/courses/1458659/pages/homework-1-solutions).
2. [IntroStatGPT: Homework Workflow](files/homework-01-workflow.pdf) — how to
   generate output, review the report outline, and export your report.
3. **Optional:** [Sample Homework 1 chat](introstatgpt/homework-01-sample-chat.qmd)
   — try generating the required output yourself first. If you get stuck, use
   this complete output-generation conversation to check your requests and
   output. It does not answer the homework questions.
4. **Optional:** [Homework 1 report skeleton](files/homework-01-report-skeleton.docx)
   — try building your own report first. This file contains known-good copies
   of the required tables and figures, with no written answers. Use it to check
   your output or as a backup if IntroStatGPT is unavailable.

Submit the PDF you export from Word.

## Homework 2

Download [IntroStatGPT_homework_02_2026-09-12.zip](files/IntroStatGPT_homework_02_2026-09-12.zip)
(444 KB). This folder contains the Homework 2 workspace, assignment, dataset,
and supplied figures. It works with Codex and Claude Code.

To start, unzip the file, open the ChatGPT desktop app, and choose **File → Open
Folder**. Select the unzipped `TEMBA-2026-homework-02-codex` folder. Do not
upload or drag the ZIP file into a chat; open the unzipped folder so the
workspace instructions and tools load correctly.

Use the workspace with these files:

1. [Homework 2: Probability and Relationships](files/homework-02.pdf) — the
   assignment.
2. **Optional:** [Sample Homework 2 chat](introstatgpt/homework-02-sample-chat.qmd)
   — try generating the required output yourself first. If you get stuck, use
   this complete output-generation conversation to check your requests and
   output. It does not answer the homework questions.
3. **Optional:** [Homework 2 report skeleton](files/homework-02-report-skeleton.docx)
   — try building your own report first. This file contains known-good copies
   of the required tables, with no written answers. Use it to check
   your output or as a backup if IntroStatGPT is unavailable.

Submit one or more PDF files. Clearly label every answer with its problem and
part number. Legible scans or photographs of handwritten pages are acceptable
once converted to PDF.

Your ability to complete any assignment, quiz, or exam never depends on an AI
tool working: known-good tables and figures are provided alongside every
assignment, and you can use them to check your own output or instead of it.
